title: PixelKin - Farlamp Sound (SNES register)
_note: Farlamp Sound / the Shelfwater / the Fogwall: rowing the Farlamp skiff over the open deep on a long swell, the far lamp blinking in the fog. The Farlamp family's sea rung: the isles' hymn as a LONE line over the sea, in D Dorian (B natural - the shanty colour), with four bars of open sea between its two lines. 80 BPM, 3/4. The bass rocks like oars (dotted root, fifth, root); the noise surf rises and falls on every two bars (the swell); the bell is the far lamp blinking - one A5 every two bars, never moving; a very soft strings bed; the flute takes the bridge line an octave down, as if heard from another boat. 32 bars, 72 s. Loops on the sea bars (no cadence to trip on). Original (VISION.md).
